name: The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa
insider_take: Desert luxury meets modern sophistication at this sprawling resort where championship golf and world-class spa treatments create the perfect Scottsdale escape.
whats_special: This AAA Four Diamond resort sits on 240 acres in North Scottsdale and features two championship golf courses designed by Scott Miller. The resort's Adventure Water Park includes a 110-foot waterslide, lazy river, and sand beach area. The Agave Spa spans 22,000 square feet and incorporates indigenous desert botanicals into its signature treatments.
pro_tip: Book tee times at the Acacia course early - it's consistently ranked among Arizona's top resort courses and features stunning views of Pinnacle Peak and the McDowell Mountains.
dont_miss: The resort's FlowRider surf simulator for year-round wave riding, desert sunset dinners at deseo restaurant, and the nearby Kierland Commons premium shopping district just steps away. The property also features a unique putting course designed to look like the state of Arizona.
pros: Prime Scottsdale location with easy access to shopping and dining at Kierland Commons
Multiple pools including lazy river and waterslide for family entertainment
Award-winning Agave Spa offering comprehensive wellness treatments
Championship golf courses and professional tennis facilities on-site
cons: Large resort property requiring significant walking between amenities
Premium pricing for resort amenities and dining options
